metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-ce[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Bob command mode: press : in Obsidian to run bob[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]Pressing `:` in Obsidian's Vim normal mode opens a fast, beautiful [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]bob command sheet. The user filters a bob-owned catalog of every [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]useful bob command, runs one with context-aware arguments and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]safe-write guards, and is notified when it finishes, with three [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]honest outcome classes (completed, needs attention, failed). The [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]full output is always one key away in a pager that doubles as run [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]history. Vim's own ex line stays reachable through `::`, Vim-shaped[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]input, and `g:`.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]11[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]8[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plan:202610/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]bob_colon_command_mode.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202610/bob_colon_command_mode.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]bob-cli-ce[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-ce/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Make the colon key safe and keep the new plugin out of vault [/bold #D7AFFF] [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
      [bold #D7AFFF]git[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]vault-prep[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]vault-prep: turn all 16 recursive `nmap … :bob_*<CR>` lines in the vault[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]vimrc into `nnoremap`, add `nnoremap g: :`, and gitignore [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`.obsidian/plugins/bob-command-mode/` in the vault, without binding `:` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]yet.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob __catalog --protocol 1[/bold #D7AFFF]                                    [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]catalog[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]catalog: add the hidden, versioned JSON command catalog to bob-cli. A [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]static table sits beside SUBCOMMANDS, positional args and about text [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]come from the clap tree, coverage tests classify every public leaf, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]a contract docs page documents it.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Color, progress, and exit receipts for non-TTY runs[/bold #D7AFFF]           [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]run-env[dim] · [dim][/dim]after catalog[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]run-env: bob honors CLICOLOR_FORCE, BOB_PROGRESS, and BOB_RUN_RECEIPT [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]without a TTY, advertises them as catalog `features`, and documents them[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]in the configuration reference.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Theme-name and relation-label completion providers[/bold #D7AFFF]            [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]completion-names[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]completion-names: complete theme names for `themes [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]hide|unhide|color|rename OLD` through a read-only theme-catalog load, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and complete relation labels for `relations hide|unhide`.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]bob-command-mode plugin scaffold and run engine[/bold #D7AFFF]               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]runner[dim] · [dim][/dim]after catalog, run-env[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]runner: create the desktop-only bob-command-mode plugin with a bob [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]resolver, child env, catalog cache, and detached file-backed runs. It [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]also adds run records and receipts, writer queue and save-before-write, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]timeouts, generic outcome classification, api.commandMode v1, and Ctrl+P[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]run commands, tested against a fake bob.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Toasts, status chip, outcome adapters, and OS notifications[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]feedback[dim] · [dim][/dim]after runner[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]feedback: replace the runner's plain notices with the three-class toast [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]cards and the live status-bar chip. It adds per-command outcome adapters[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and their action buttons, OS notifications for long unfocused runs, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]Rerun last command, and a Chromium preview harness for visual review.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Output pager and run history[/bold #D7AFFF]                                  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]pager[dim] · [dim][/dim]after feedback[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]pager: build the streaming output pager. It renders ANSI color, marks [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]stderr, pretty-prints JSON, links vault references, and adds Vim-style [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]keys, search, copy, rerun, stop, and history stepping. Show last output [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and the toasts' Output action open it.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]The bottom command sheet[/bold #D7AFFF]                                      [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]sheet[dim] · [dim][/dim]after pager[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]sheet: build the `Bob: Command mode` bottom sheet. It has fuzzy ranking [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]with keywords and frecency, Recent, For this note, and From clipboard [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]sections, surface rows, preview-first and confirm flows, `?` help, and [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]in-place growth into the pager for reports.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Argument mode, typed runs, Vim routing, and binding the colon [bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]key[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]args-vim[dim] · [dim][/dim]after sheet, vault-prep, completion-names[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]args-vim: add argument mode backed by `bob __complete`, a quote-aware [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]tokenizer for typed bob argv with excluded-command refusal, and Vim [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]routing (`::`, Vim-shaped input, fallback row, handleEx). It also adds [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the vimrc lint, then binds `:` in the vault vimrc.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  10 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Move Snapshot to Highlights onto the runner and refresh [/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
       [bold #D7AFFF]ledger caches[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]integrations[dim] · [dim][/dim]after pager[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]integrations: bob-project-tasks' Snapshot note to Highlights runs [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]through api.commandMode when it is available, and bob-ledger-tools [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]refreshes the caches a finished run invalidates.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  11 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Guide, reference polish, and end-to-end verification[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]docs-land[dim] · [dim][/dim]after args-vim, integrations[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]docs-land: write the "Run bob from Obsidian" guide, finish the plugin [/#D7D7AF]
